column1: # Budgets of the synthetic scale benchmark (cmd/scalebench, workflow scale.yml):
# step, files in the tree, max wall seconds, max peak resident MiB.
# Measured on Linux, 4 CPUs, ext4 with inline data, tiny files (a tenth of
# them duplicated), cold page cache not forced, no hash cache:
#   1M: stats 14 s 530 MiB, stats-full 15 s 560 MiB, catalog 11 s 27 MiB,
#       merge-preview 47 s 2.2 GiB, dedupe-preview 24 s 600 MiB.
# Budgets give about 2x the time and 1.5x the memory. 5M and 10M are scaled
# from 1M until a run measures them; merge holds every record in memory
# (about 2.2 GiB per million files), so at 10M it needs more than the 16 GB
# of a standard runner: "-" skips it there.
